planning_notes: The request for 5 EASY targets was fulfilled by selecting the 5 most distinct core concepts and mechanisms from the available list. To ensure non-redundancy, I mapped each target to a unique pedagogical facet: CONCEPT_UNDERSTANDING for the high-level definition of context switching, CODE_INTERPRETATION for the specific syntax of collection creation, OUTPUT_PREDICTION for the result of a simple insertion, MISCONCEPTION_TARGETING for the distinction between dropping a collection vs. deleting documents, and PRACTICAL_APPLICATION for the basic workflow of switching databases before inserting data. This covers the full lifecycle (switch -> create -> insert -> manage) without repeating the same concept under different angles, as the concepts themselves are distinct enough to support 5 unique easy-level items.
